description: Full-body native pixel-art game sprite, STRICTLY FRONT SOUTH view: face, nose, chest, belt and knees directly toward viewer, both ears equally visible. No sideways head or three-quarter turn. IDENTITY: Adult woman, natural slender build, oval face and warm restrained smile, narrow muted brown-gray eyes. Dark brown hair center-parted with long curved cheek-length side locks, gathered in a low rounded bun behind head. Navy-blue fitted single-breasted trouser suit, white shirt, navy tie. Bare face, no mask or glasses. Thin plain rings on fingers. Relaxed upright stance, empty hands at sides. Natural adult anatomy, normal torso/pelvis, 7-head proportions. Anatomical crown to soles 200-206px; feet 6px above bottom, hair fully inside frame. Crisp single-pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained game-sprite shading, no antialiasing. Transparent background, no ground shadow, text or weapons. Preserve individual hair, face, stature and clothing. Do not copy any generic character. Anatomical height excludes high hair/headwear. Every outer edge must border transparency directly, never a light gray halo. Use target anatomical height at reference pixel scale. Feet at y250, crown around y47. Do not copy reference identity or body fat.
